brief: Flower bouquets delivered to your door, $55-100. Occasion-driven - birthdays, anniversaries, Mother's Day. Same or next day matters a lot to us.

profile.business_summary: A direct-to-consumer flower delivery service offering bouquets priced between $55 and $100, specifically targeting occasion-driven gifting such as birthdays, anniversaries, and Mother's Day, with a strong operational focus on same-day or next-day delivery.
stated_claims: Flower bouquets delivered to your door, $55-100.
Same or next day matters a lot to us.
profile.fulfillment_notes: Same or next day delivery is highly prioritized.

relevant_tags.why: The product is explicitly occasion-driven for birthdays, anniversaries, and Mother's Day.
Flowers are a common home decor and aesthetic enhancement product.
Strong emphasis on same-day or next-day delivery fulfillment.
Delivered to your door with same or next day fulfillment.

note_signals.why: Swiftcart's focus on instant delivery and convenience aligns perfectly with the advertiser's need for same/next day delivery.
Heartfoot has a strong gifting audience, which aligns well with occasion-driven flower purchases.
Hearthstone Goods notes that gifting and life events drive purchases, matching the advertiser's occasion-driven model.

profile.gate_reason: The product, price range, target use case (gifting), and fulfillment expectations are clearly defined and ready for planning.

assumptions: Price not given; assumed $90 for a 'premium' product.
Margin not given; assumed 55% (typical for home) for the break-even estimate only.
Break-even per customer (guidance, not enforced): $90 x 55% x 1.0 orders = $49.50.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $2.50 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented. Guidance: at the assumed margin, a click is worth about $0.59; bidding above that loses money per customer. Set a target CPA or a lower max CPC to enforce it.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: score 0.31, relative fit x1.40; 0.0096 conversions/$ at the start, falling as the host saturates; bid $1.75 (cap $2.50)
score 0.24, relative fit x1.22; 0.0096 conversions/$ at the start, falling as the host saturates; bid $1.52 (cap $2.17)

phases.why: stable bids so measured CTR/CVR aren't confounded

phases.name: maximize
phases.rule: bid = start x pacing x conversion likelihood, within [floor, cap]: spend the budget on the best opportunities
phases.why: no CPA target was set, so the goal is the most units for the budget

adjustments.reason: Under-delivering vs the daily plan -> bid up a little; over-delivering -> bid down.

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget, never above the $2.50 cap (category default).
